title: Wimbourne pharmacy label outage report
brief: I'm the pharmacy systems manager at Wimbourne General Hospital and I need the incident report for the dispensing label outage on Tuesday 2026-10-06, for the hospital's quality committee, who will read it on laptops before their meeting. Open with the impact: 158 minutes with no label printing in the pharmacy, 214 prescriptions delayed by an average of 47 minutes, a peak of 66 prescriptions waiting at 08:30, and no wrong-drug events. Under "Waiting prescriptions" chart the queue at half-hour marks: 07:00 0, 07:30 12, 08:00 41, 08:30 66, 09:00 38, 09:30 9, 10:00 0. Under "Timeline": 07:12 the label print server ran out of disk space and stopped; 07:24 pharmacists noticed labels not printing; 07:41 the helpdesk ticket was escalated to Anil Deshmukh; 08:03 paper labels began under pharmacy lead Dr. Helen Okafor; 09:12 Anil freed space and restarted the server; 09:50 the backlog was cleared. Under "Cause": a driver update on 2026-10-01 doubled the size of the logs, and nothing watched the disk. Under "Follow-ups", with owner and date: alert when the disk passes 80 percent, Anil Deshmukh, 2026-10-16; rotate and cap the logs, Mei Tanaka, 2026-10-13; rehearse the paper label fallback with night staff, Dr. Helen Okafor, 2026-11-06. Flag that it took 39 minutes from noticing the fault to starting paper labels, which is too slow.

edit.request: Change the paper-label rehearsal date to 2026-11-20, and correct the peak waiting figure from 66 to 71 in both the headline and the chart.
